title: Crispy Norwegian Hash
description: A simple yet satisfying breakfast dish that combines crispy Norwegian hash with ham and scrambled eggs.
instructions: 1. In a large pan, scramble the eggs over medium heat.
2. Season the scrambled eggs with salt and pepper to taste.
3. Add the thinly sliced yellowed ham to the pan and stir to combine.
4. Add the crispy Norwegian hash to the pan and stir to combine.
5. Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
6. Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes if the hash is not crispy enough.
